The error is a FileNotFoundException for the orders CSV, and the runbook sends missing or unreadable data files to ops. But the table has different rows for different causes, so the same hand-off doesn't hold for every case, and otherwise I'd investigate. I'm weighing whether to call the sorter first, since it decides which department the manager sees.

I'm going with the assumption that the case has already been sorted, so I'll settle on investigating and brief the investigator.

arguments.reason: The runbook's Decisions table gives different decisions for different causes (auto-fix for a certain crash in this method's code, hand-off to ops if the data file is missing or unreadable, person if uncertain), so the cause has to be found first, per rule 4 of the decision procedure.

{"id": "5c1e9a0f2b77", "timestamp": "2026-11-24T12:16:20.0300353+00:00", "service": "order-service", "method": "get-order", "arguments": "1001", "exception_type": "System.IO.FileNotFoundException", "message": "Could not find file '/app/data/orders.csv'.", "stack_trace": "   at System.IO.FileSystem.OpenHandle(String fullPath)\n   at System.IO.File.ReadLines(String path)\n   at OrderService.OrderRepository..ctor(String csvPath) in src/OrderService/Orders.cs:line 22\n   at Program.<Main>$(String[] args) in src/OrderService/Program.cs:line 8"}

Runbook for get-order:
What it does: GET /orders/{id} - a one-line summary of an order: id, customer, number of items and the first item's SKU (Api/GetOrder.cs). Read-only. It reads the service's data file, data/orders.csv, which the deploy puts beside the service.
Expected (no action): OrderService.OrderNotFoundException (404) only.
Decisions:
- a crash in this method's code, cause certain: a lookup must never crash on an order that exists, including one with no items -> auto-fix (coder)
- the data file, data/orders.csv, missing or unreadable, or where it is deployed -> hand-off (ops)
- a fix that is not confirmed, or a cause that isn't certain -> person (orders)
Expected behaviour: every order in the data returns its summary; an order without items says 0 items and no first SKU; unknown ids still throw OrderNotFoundException.

Find where the cause is: is the crash in this method's code, or is the data file missing or unreadable / wrongly deployed? Check the stack trace against the code (OrderRepository constructor in src/OrderService/Orders.cs line 22 and Program.cs), and check how the path /app/data/orders.csv is set and whether the repo puts data/orders.csv where the code expects. Report with ReportInvestigation: where, cause in one sentence, area (code, data, hosting, third-party or unknown), and confidence (low, medium, high).
